segments.name: Fresh Fruit
segments.description: Grows, sources and distributes bananas, pineapples and plantains from Latin American farms, and offers cargo capacity on its vessels to customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: Fresh Fruit: This segment encompasses our market-leading, vertically integrated production and distribution of bananas, pineapples and plantains primarily.

segments.name: Diversified Fresh Produce – EMEA
products: imported and local fresh fruits and vegetables
segments.description: Sells imported and local fresh fruits and vegetables, and manages produce categories, for retail, wholesale, foodservice and e-commerce customers in Europe.
segments.evidence: The majority of these businesses sell a variety of imported and local fresh fruits and vegetables via retail, wholesale, foodservice and e-commerce channels across Europe.

segments.name: Diversified Fresh Produce – Americas & ROW
segments.description: Markets globally and locally sourced fresh produce, including avocados, kiwis, apples, berries and cherries, to wholesale and retail customers in the Americas.
segments.evidence: We market globally and locally sourced fresh produce, including avocados, kiwis, apples, berries and cherries.

revenueModel.text: Grocery stores, wholesalers, foodservice operators, club and convenience stores and distributors pay Dole for fresh fruit and vegetables and for cargo capacity on its vessels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include leading grocery stores, wholesalers, mass merchandisers, supercenters, foodservice operators, club stores, convenience stores, distributors and smaller regional customers.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold its Fresh Vegetables division, whose results are now reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: The Vegetables Transaction included substantially all of the assets and liabilities of the former Fresh Vegetables segment.

changes.text: In 2024 the company completed the sale of its Progressive Produce business within the Americas & ROW segment.
changes.evidence: On March 13, 2024, Dole completed the Progressive Transaction, and the Company concluded that the Progressive Transaction was a triggering event for the Diversified Fresh Produce – Americas & ROW reporting unit.
